The barometer RESET/EOC swap (and its pull-up) is the explicitly logged V1 bug, not an anomaly, and the PCA9685 is deliberately strapped to 0x41 (A0→+3V3, note 'I2C address: 0x41') to avoid an address clash with the INA219 (0x40) on the same I2C2_FCC bus — a correct adaptation rather than a deviation. No drawing-supported anomaly was found.
